bug_fixed.issue: TypeError: can't compare offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes in get_active_scheduled_text endpoint
bug_fixed.root_cause: When start_datetime is stored without timezone info (e.g., '2026-02-13T18:00:00'), parsing it creates a naive datetime that can't be compared with timezone-aware 'now'
bug_fixed.fix: Added timezone awareness check and fallback to UTC if datetime is naive
